injuries.detail: Murphy (knees) is listed as probable for Monday's game against the Suns.

Williamson (thigh) is probable for Monday's game against Phoenix.
Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
Dunn (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Pelicans.
